# Devrani Jewellers (DRJ) / Devrani Traders

> Devrani Jewellers (DRJ) is the premier trusted jewellery showroom in Sitamarhi, Bihar, specializing in 100% BIS Hallmarked 916 22K Gold, 24K pure gold coins & bullion, and 925 Sterling Silver ornaments.

## Key Information
- **Store Name**: Devrani Jewellers (DRJ)
- **Legal Entity**: Devrani Traders (देवरानी ट्रेडर्स)
- **City & State**: Sitamarhi, Bihar, India (PIN: 843302)
- **Primary Address**: Sona Patti Road, Near Aloo Gaddi, Badi Bazar (Near Janki Mandir), Sitamarhi, Bihar 843302
- **Landmark**: Near Aloo Gaddi / Janki Mandir (जानकी स्थान)
- **Primary Phone & WhatsApp**: +91 98350 75841
- **Secondary Contact**: +91 92048 58261
- **Website**: https://jewellary-xi.vercel.app/
- **Official Google Maps**: https://maps.app.goo.gl/9b3mSjSSaxLzwm688
- **Coordinates**: Latitude 26.5938761, Longitude 85.4845809
- **Operating Hours**: Monday to Sunday, 10:00 AM – 8:00 PM (Open all 7 days)

## Product Categories & Offerings
- **Gold Jewellery**: 22K (916) & 18K Hallmarked Necklaces, Bridal Chokers, Bangles, Kadas, Mangalsutras, Chains, Earrings, Jhumkas, Finger Rings.
- **Silver Jewellery & Articles**: 925 Sterling Silver Payal (Anklets), Bichhiya (Toe Rings), Silver Coins, Pooja Thalis, Idols, and Utensils.
- **Investment Bullion**: 24K (999 Purity) Gold Bars & Certified Gold Coins.
- **Bespoke Bridal Crafting**: Custom handcrafted wedding jewellery sets customized by master Bengali goldsmiths.

## Certifications & Quality Assurances
- **100% BIS Hallmark with 6-Digit HUID**: Every gold ornament is laser-inscribed with the unique government HUID code verifiable on the BIS Care App.
- **Precision Digital Scales**: Calibrated digital weighing with 100% net weight transparency.
- **Fair Pricing**: Daily live bullion market rates with competitive transparent making charges.
- **Customer Service**: Lifetime gold exchange at prevailing market rates and 7-day unworn exchange with bill.
